newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Ippa bank plans Euro index-linked fund.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Ippa bank plans Euro index-linked fund.

text.p: Belgian Ippa Bank, a unit of insurance company Royale Belge, said on Friday it would launch an investment fund designed to track a basket of four European stock indices.

Investplus Europe 2001, which matures on December 20, 2001, guarantees savers 100 percent of their initial investment and 100 percent of any upward movement in the basket, Ippa said in a statement. The indices to be tracked are: Brussels Bel-20, Amsterdam AEX, Paris CAC-40 and Frankfurt's DAX.
Subscriptions open on May 20 and close on June 12.
